brief: The canvas presents a vast, dynamically shifting lattice of interconnected, glowing cells simulating a biological life cycle. The entire field pulses slowly and visibly, rhythmically darkening and brightening as a wave of energy washes over it. Cells are never static; they flash brightly when they expire and radiate a soft, residual glow when they are born. Furthermore, every genesis event is marked by thin, luminous connection lines that appear briefly. This sophisticated system evolves constantly, maintaining a rich tapestry of glowing forms without needing any direct user input.

statement: This sketch creates a living lattice of glowing cells that simulate a biological life cycle. Each cell pulses with its own rhythm, growing bright when born and fading as it ages, while a gentle wave effect subtly darkens and brightens the entire field. The system evolves autonomously without any user input, with new cells constantly being born in a natural, organic pattern. The visual effect captures the essence of a dynamic biological ecosystem where life cycles intersect and overlap, creating an ever-shifting tapestry of light and shadow that pulses with its own internal rhythm.
